Denton Property Data Profile

Everything in Denton CAD's 2026 PACS Appraisal Export, downloaded from the CAD website: 20 files per export, in two snapshots — the certified roll exported July 27 and supplement 3 exported October 14. The year switch on every tab picks the snapshot. For each file you get its columns, data types, completeness and value distributions.
